checks.text: Checkout says a big order pays the delivery charge first
Cancelled before sending: half of the delivery charge paid goes back, and the page says the other half stays for the handling

shots.caption: The shopper's order: the delivery charge comes first
The owner marks the delivery charge as received
The shopper cancels before it was sent

did: With "delivery charge paid first" switched on for this order size, a shopper ordered a box of Napa to be delivered. The owner saw the charge had to come first, marked it received, then cancelled the order before sending. The shopper's order page was read.
